label: Applying directly to a Hungarian university

milestones.label: Each university's own closing date
milestones.note: English-taught programmes are applied for on each university's own portal, not through the national felvi.hu system. Dates differ: Semmelweis closes medicine on 31 May 2027; Pécs takes applications from 1 November 2026 to 30 June 2027 and admits continuously. Several universities fill places as applications arrive, so treat a published deadline as the last possible day.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: After most Hungarian deadlines. You apply on predicted grades and entrance exams, and upload the Diploma once you have it.

milestones.label: Semmelweis: upload your school-leaving certificate
milestones.note: Semmelweis only. Published as a standing rule, '21st of August the year of application', so the year is inferred. Other universities set their own document deadline.

supplementarySteps: Most English-taught medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and veterinary programmes set their own entrance exam, often online. Book it early: at several schools the exam slot is what decides when you can be admitted.
CEU is listed with Hungary but teaches its bachelor's degrees in Vienna.

notes: Applying directly is the finding. The national felvi.hu / E-felvételi system covers Hungarian-language and state-funded places; the English-taught programmes behind this page run their own portals (Semmelweis SEMAPHOR, BME e-admission, apply.mome.hu, apply.metropolitan.hu, Pécs and Corvinus online forms).
Per-institution dates live on the country profile's deadline list. No single date is recorded as the route's closing date, because one university's date would stand in for thirteen others.
